strings.zh: 紫苑镇的居民常喜欢传一些{NEWLINE}不着边际的灵异传闻,{CLEAR}其实那些灵异事件{CLEAR}不过是幽灵系口袋妖怪的恶作剧罢了。{SCROLL}恶系技能可以对幽灵系口袋妖怪{NEWLINE}造成比较可观的伤害,{CLEAR}既然你来到了紫苑镇,{CLEAR}要不要跟我学一招恶系技能防身啊？{SCROLL}只要给我1个重量球,{NEWLINE}我就教你恶系技能暗袭要害。{CLEAR}怎么样,要学吗？
strings.en: The folks in Lavender Town love to{NEWLINE}spread wild ghost stories.{SCROLL}But those ghostly happenings are really{NEWLINE}just pranks by Ghost-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Dark-type moves do good damage to{NEWLINE}Ghost-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}Since you’ve come to Lavender Town,{NEWLINE}why not learn a Dark-type move from me,{CLEAR}just in case?{SCROLL}Give me one Heavy Ball, and I’ll teach{NEWLINE}your Pokémon the Dark-type move Night{CLEAR}Slash. What do you say?

strings.zh: 精灵都是会死的吗？{SCROLL}那些上古传说中的神兽{NEWLINE}也逃不过生老病死吗？
strings.en: Do all Pokémon die?{SCROLL}Even the divine Pokémon of the ancient{NEWLINE}legends? Can’t they escape birth, age,{CLEAR}sickness and death either?

strings.zh: 之前火箭队来这里大翻特翻,{NEWLINE}连坟墓的盖子都打开了！{SCROLL}天啊……精灵们即便是死了{NEWLINE}也要遭到火箭队的欺辱吗？
strings.en: When Team Rocket came here and turned{NEWLINE}the place upside down, they even opened{CLEAR}up the graves!{SCROLL}Oh my... Even after they die, do{NEWLINE}Pokémon still have to suffer at Team{CLEAR}Rocket’s hands?

strings.zh: 人家都说友情是钻石,{NEWLINE}回忆是珍珠。{CLEAR}只要你给我1颗代表回忆的大珍珠,{CLEAR}我就送你1片能唤醒记忆的心之鳞片。{CLEAR}怎么样,要交换吗？
strings.en: They say friendship is a diamond, and{NEWLINE}memories are pearls.{SCROLL}If you give me one Big Pearl, which{NEWLINE}stands for memories, I’ll give you one{CLEAR}Heart Scale, which can wake up{CLEAR}memories. Want to trade?

strings.zh: 我养过好几只精灵,{NEWLINE}但是它们最终都莫名其妙地死去了……{CLEAR}只有这只凯西一直陪我到现在。{SCROLL}失去伙伴真的好痛苦啊……
strings.en: I’ve raised several Pokémon, but they{NEWLINE}all died one after another, for no{CLEAR}reason I could understand...{SCROLL}Only this Abra has stayed with me all{NEWLINE}this time.{SCROLL}Losing a partner hurts so much...

strings.zh: 凯西『Aaaa——bra！
strings.en: Abra: Aaaa-bra!

strings.zh: 那我就收下你的大珍珠啦。

strings.zh: 作为交换,给你这片心之鳞片。
strings.en: In exchange, here’s a Heart Scale for{NEWLINE}you.

strings.zh: 希望这个世界上不再有{NEWLINE}火箭队这样以强欺弱的邪恶组织。
strings.en: I hope there’s never again an evil gang{NEWLINE}like Team Rocket that bullies the weak.

strings.zh: 我在10号路遇到了一位绝世美女,{NEWLINE}她的倾城容颜让我无法忘怀,{CLEAR}可是当我再次去10号路找她时,{CLEAR}她却不见了……{SCROLL}我的女神啊,你究竟在那里……{NEWLINE}我也好想你啊！
strings.en: On Route 10, I met a woman of peerless{NEWLINE}beauty.{SCROLL}I can’t forget her stunning face.{SCROLL}But when I went back to Route 10 to{NEWLINE}find her, she was gone...{SCROLL}Oh, my goddess, where are you... I want{NEWLINE}to see you so much, too!

strings.zh: 虽然我不认识你,{NEWLINE}但我感受得到{CLEAR}你就是个心狠手辣的魔鬼！
strings.en: I don’t know you, but I can feel it...{NEWLINE}You’re a ruthless devil!
